title: Phaestus
summary: Raleigh names Phaestus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Phaestus, the two and twentieth King of Sicyonia, who reigned eight yeeres in the time of Thola. He is not Hephaestus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VII, sig. 271b
